---- MODULE W4Od18m4p3t1 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

Controllers == {"c1", "c2"}
Locks == {"L1", "L2"}
QCAP == 3
MAXDROP == 2

VARIABLES queue, grants, done, drops

vars == <<queue, grants, done, drops>>

Cmd == [ctl : Controllers, lock : Locks]

GrantedLocks == {g[2] : g \in grants}

TypeOK ==
    /\ queue \subseteq Cmd
    /\ grants \subseteq (Controllers \X Locks)
    /\ done \subseteq (Controllers \X Locks)
    /\ drops \in 0..MAXDROP

Init ==
    /\ queue = {}
    /\ grants = {}
    /\ done = {}
    /\ drops = 0

Submit(c, k) ==
    /\ k \notin GrantedLocks
    /\ [ctl |-> c, lock |-> k] \notin queue
    /\ Cardinality(queue) < QCAP
    /\ queue' = queue \cup {[ctl |-> c, lock |-> k]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<grants, done, drops>>

DropFull(c, k) ==
    /\ Cardinality(queue) = QCAP
    /\ drops < MAXDROP
    /\ [ctl |-> c, lock |-> k] \notin queue
    /\ drops' = drops + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, grants, done>>

Process(m) ==
    /\ m \in queue
    /\ m.lock \notin GrantedLocks
    /\ grants' = grants \cup {<<m.ctl, m.lock>>}
    /\ queue' = queue \ {m}
    /\ done' = done \cup {<<m.ctl, m.lock>>}
    /\ UNCHANGED drops

Discard(m) ==
    /\ m \in queue
    /\ m.lock \in GrantedLocks
    /\ queue' = queue \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<grants, done, drops>>

Release(g) ==
    /\ g \in grants
    /\ grants' = grants \ {g}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, done, drops>>

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Controllers, k \in Locks : Submit(c, k)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers, k \in Locks : DropFull(c, k)
    \/ \E m \in queue : Process(m)
    \/ \E m \in queue : Discard(m)
    \/ \E g \in grants : Release(g)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoDoubleGrant ==
    \A g1 \in grants, g2 \in grants :
        (g1[2] = g2[2]) => (g1[1] = g2[1])

====
nl:
A smart-home door-lock network dispatches lock/unlock commands through a bounded
work queue. Home controllers submit a command that targets a specific door lock
(a "slot"). The queue holds at most a fixed number of pending commands; this is
its backpressure limit. When a controller tries to submit while the queue is
full, the command is not queued at all -- it is dropped and counted against a
small drop budget (the DropFull action). Two different controllers may each queue
a command for the same lock. A dispatcher worker does NOT process the queue in
order -- because radio messages can be reordered, it may pick ANY pending command
from the queue. When it picks a command whose target lock is not currently
allocated, it grants that lock to the requesting controller (the Process action).
When it picks a command whose target lock has meanwhile been granted to someone,
it discards the stale command without granting (the Discard action). A granted
lock can be released, freeing it for a future grant (the Release action).
Actions: Submit, DropFull, Process, Discard, Release.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the same door lock is never granted to two different controllers at the same time.

---- MODULE W4Od19m3p1t3 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

Nodes == {"n1", "n2", "n3"}
NONE == "none"
MAXSEQ == 3
MAXTERM == 2

VARIABLES leader, term, committed, nextseq, view

vars == <<leader, term, committed, nextseq, view>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ leader \in Nodes \cup {NONE}
    /\ term \in 0..MAXTERM
    /\ committed \subseteq 1..MAXSEQ
    /\ nextseq \in 1..(MAXSEQ + 1)
    /\ view \in [Nodes -> 0..MAXSEQ]

Init ==
    /\ leader = NONE
    /\ term = 0
    /\ committed = {}
    /\ nextseq = 1
    /\ view = [n \in Nodes |-> 0]

Elect(n) ==
    /\ leader = NONE
    /\ leader' = n
    /\ term' = IF term < MAXTERM THEN term + 1 ELSE term
    /\ UNCHANGED <<committed, nextseq, view>>

Commit(n) ==
    /\ leader = n
    /\ nextseq <= MAXSEQ
    /\ committed' = committed \cup {nextseq}
    /\ view' = [view EXCEPT ![n] = nextseq]
    /\ nextseq' = nextseq + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term>>

Replicate(n) ==
    /\ leader # NONE
    /\ view[n] < view[leader]
    /\ view' = [view EXCEPT ![n] = view[leader]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, committed, nextseq>>

StepDown ==
    /\ leader # NONE
    /\ leader' = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, committed, nextseq, view>>

Next ==
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Elect(n)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Commit(n)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Replicate(n)
    \/ StepDown

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoLostUpdate ==
    committed = { s \in 1..MAXSEQ : s < nextseq }

====
nl:
A library book-reservation system replicates a shared reservation log across
several server nodes. Exactly one node acts as leader and is the only node
allowed to commit a new reservation. Each committed reservation is assigned the
next sequence number in an unbroken 1,2,3,... order, and the leader records it in
the shared committed log (the Commit action). Follower nodes are slow but never
fail: a follower may lag behind, and it catches up by copying the leader's known
position up to the committed frontier (the Replicate action). Leadership can fail
over: the current leader may step down, leaving the system with no leader (the
StepDown action), after which any node may be elected the new leader for a fresh
term (the Elect action). A newly elected leader continues numbering from the
existing committed log; it never restarts numbering. Actions: Elect, Commit,
Replicate, StepDown.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the committed reservation log is always exactly the contiguous range 1..N with no gaps and no lost sequence numbers.

---- MODULE W4Od17m1p4t2 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

Stations == {"s1", "s2", "s3"}
CAP == 3
MAXDRAIN == 3

RingNext(s) == CASE s = "s1" -> "s2"
                 [] s = "s2" -> "s3"
                 [] s = "s3" -> "s1"

VARIABLES token1, token2, pool, drained

vars == <<token1, token2, pool, drained>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ token1 \in Stations
    /\ token2 \in Stations
    /\ pool \in 0..CAP
    /\ drained \in 0..MAXDRAIN

Init ==
    /\ token1 = "s1"
    /\ token2 = "s1"
    /\ pool = 0
    /\ drained = 0

PassToken1 ==
    /\ token1' = RingNext(token1)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token2, pool, drained>>

PassToken2 ==
    /\ token2' = RingNext(token2)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token1, pool, drained>>

Load1(s) ==
    /\ s = token1
    /\ pool < CAP
    /\ pool' = pool + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token1, token2, drained>>

Load2(s) ==
    /\ s = token2
    /\ pool < CAP
    /\ pool' = pool + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token1, token2, drained>>

Unload ==
    /\ pool > 0
    /\ drained < MAXDRAIN
    /\ pool' = pool - 1
    /\ drained' = drained + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token1, token2>>

Next ==
    \/ PassToken1
    \/ PassToken2
    \/ \E s \in Stations : Load1(s)
    \/ \E s \in Stations : Load2(s)
    \/ Unload

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

BoundedPool == pool <= CAP

====
nl:
An airport baggage router uses a token ring to grant exclusive loading rights.
There are two independent router instances (instance 1 and instance 2), each with
its own ring of stations and its own single circulating token; a station may load
a bag only while it holds its instance's token, and the token advances one station
around the ring at a time (the PassToken1 and PassToken2 actions). Although the
two instances are independent, they feed one shared collection pool that has a
fixed maximum capacity. A token-holding station loads one bag into the shared pool
only when the pool is below capacity (the Load1 and Load2 actions). A downstream
carousel drains one bag from the shared pool when it is non-empty (the Unload
action), counted against a small drain budget. Actions: PassToken1, PassToken2,
Load1, Load2, Unload.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the number of bags in the shared collection pool never exceeds its fixed maximum capacity.

---- MODULE W4Od15m0p3t3 ----
EXTENDS Integers

Traders == {"t1", "t2"}
Slots == {"a1", "a2"}
NONE == "none"
MAXVER == 3

VARIABLES owner, claimed, ver, rd, tgt

vars == <<owner, claimed, ver, rd, tgt>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ owner \in [Slots -> Traders \cup {NONE}]
    /\ claimed \in [Traders -> Slots \cup {NONE}]
    /\ ver \in 0..MAXVER
    /\ rd \in [Traders -> (-1)..MAXVER]
    /\ tgt \in [Traders -> Slots \cup {NONE}]

Init ==
    /\ owner = [s \in Slots |-> NONE]
    /\ claimed = [t \in Traders |-> NONE]
    /\ ver = 0
    /\ rd = [t \in Traders |-> -1]
    /\ tgt = [t \in Traders |-> NONE]

Read(t, s) ==
    /\ ver < MAXVER
    /\ tgt[t] = NONE
    /\ owner[s] = NONE
    /\ rd' = [rd EXCEPT ![t] = ver]
    /\ tgt' = [tgt EXCEPT ![t] = s]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, claimed, ver>>

Commit(t) ==
    /\ tgt[t] # NONE
    /\ rd[t] = ver
    /\ ver < MAXVER
    /\ owner[tgt[t]] = NONE
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![tgt[t]] = t]
    /\ claimed' = [claimed EXCEPT ![t] = tgt[t]]
    /\ ver' = ver + 1
    /\ rd' = [rd EXCEPT ![t] = -1]
    /\ tgt' = [tgt EXCEPT ![t] = NONE]

Retry(t) ==
    /\ tgt[t] # NONE
    /\ (rd[t] # ver \/ owner[tgt[t]] # NONE)
    /\ rd' = [rd EXCEPT ![t] = -1]
    /\ tgt' = [tgt EXCEPT ![t] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, claimed, ver>>

Release(t) ==
    /\ claimed[t] # NONE
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![claimed[t]] = NONE]
    /\ claimed' = [claimed EXCEPT ![t] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ver, rd, tgt>>

NewRound ==
    /\ ver = MAXVER
    /\ \A t \in Traders : tgt[t] = NONE
    /\ ver' = 0
    /\ owner' = [s \in Slots |-> NONE]
    /\ claimed' = [t \in Traders |-> NONE]
    /\ rd' = [t \in Traders |-> -1]
    /\ UNCHANGED tgt

Next ==
    \/ \E t \in Traders, s \in Slots : Read(t, s)
    \/ \E t \in Traders : Commit(t)
    \/ \E t \in Traders : Retry(t)
    \/ \E t \in Traders : Release(t)
    \/ NewRound

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoDoubleAlloc ==
    \A t1 \in Traders, t2 \in Traders :
        (claimed[t1] # NONE /\ claimed[t1] = claimed[t2]) => (t1 = t2)

====
nl:
A stock-exchange opening auction allocates scarce price-time execution slots to
traders using optimistic locking with retry. A shared registry has a version
number that is bumped on every successful allocation. To claim a free slot, a
trader first reads the current version and picks a target slot (the Read action).
It then attempts to commit: the commit succeeds only if the registry version is
still the one it read (an optimistic compare-and-set) and the slot is still free,
in which case the trader is recorded as the slot's owner and the version is bumped
(the Commit action). A trader can be slow but never fails: if by commit time the
version has moved on because another trader got in first, the slow trader's
attempt is stale, so it abandons and will read again later (the Retry action). An
owner may release its slot back to the free pool (the Release action). At the end of a round, once no attempts are in flight and
the version counter is exhausted, the auction resets: the version rolls back to
zero and all slots are freed for the next round (the NewRound action). Actions:
Read, Commit, Retry, Release, NewRound.
SAFETY PROPERTY: no two different traders are ever recorded as owning the same execution slot.

---- MODULE W4Od3m6p4t4 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

Banks == {"b1", "b2", "b3"}
MAXCAP == 3
MAXCLOCK == 3
LEASELEN == 2

VARIABLES load, cap, lease, clock

vars == <<load, cap, lease, clock>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ load \in 0..MAXCAP
    /\ cap \in 1..MAXCAP
    /\ lease \in [Banks -> 0..(MAXCLOCK + LEASELEN)]
    /\ clock \in 0..MAXCLOCK

Init ==
    /\ load = 0
    /\ cap = 1
    /\ lease = [b \in Banks |-> 0]
    /\ clock = 0

AcquireLease(b) ==
    /\ lease[b] = 0
    /\ lease' = [lease EXCEPT ![b] = clock + LEASELEN]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<load, cap, clock>>

Settle(b) ==
    /\ lease[b] # 0
    /\ lease[b] > clock
    /\ load < cap
    /\ load' = load + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<cap, lease, clock>>

ExpireLease(b) ==
    /\ lease[b] # 0
    /\ lease[b] <= clock
    /\ lease' = [lease EXCEPT ![b] = 0]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<load, cap, clock>>

Tick ==
    /\ clock < MAXCLOCK
    /\ clock' = clock + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<load, cap, lease>>

ChangeCap ==
    /\ \E c \in 1..MAXCAP : c >= load /\ cap' = c
    /\ UNCHANGED <<load, lease, clock>>

Flush ==
    /\ load > 0
    /\ load' = 0
    /\ UNCHANGED <<cap, lease, clock>>

Next ==
    \/ \E b \in Banks : AcquireLease(b)
    \/ \E b \in Banks : Settle(b)
    \/ \E b \in Banks : ExpireLease(b)
    \/ Tick
    \/ ChangeCap
    \/ Flush

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

LoadWithinCap == load <= cap

====
nl:
A bank's interbank settlement batch collects settlement entries into a batch
buffer that has a maximum capacity. Member banks use lease-based ownership to add
entries: a bank first acquires a time-limited lease stamped with an expiry tick
(the AcquireLease action). While its lease is still valid (its expiry is in the
future relative to the shared clock), the bank may place one settlement entry into
the batch, but only when the batch is below its current capacity (the Settle
action). A lease whose expiry has passed is reclaimed and the bank must lease
again (the ExpireLease action). A shared clock advances one tick at a time (the
Tick action). The batch's capacity is not fixed: an operator may change it at
runtime, but it is never lowered below the number of entries already in the batch
(the ChangeCap action). When a batch is settled it is flushed empty so it can fill
again (the Flush action). Actions: AcquireLease, Settle, ExpireLease, Tick,
ChangeCap, Flush.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the number of entries in the batch never exceeds the batch's current capacity.

---- MODULE W4Od16m2p1t4 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

Parts == {"p1", "p2", "p3"}
MAXCAP == 2

VARIABLES phase, vote, decision, applied, cap

vars == <<phase, vote, decision, applied, cap>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ phase \in {"idle", "voting", "decided"}
    /\ vote \in [Parts -> {"none", "yes", "no"}]
    /\ decision \in {"none", "commit", "abort"}
    /\ applied \in [Parts -> {"none", "commit", "abort"}]
    /\ cap \in 0..MAXCAP

Init ==
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ vote = [p \in Parts |-> "none"]
    /\ decision = "none"
    /\ applied = [p \in Parts |-> "none"]
    /\ cap = 0

StartVote ==
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ phase' = "voting"
    /\ vote' = [p \in Parts |-> "none"]
    /\ decision' = "none"
    /\ applied' = [p \in Parts |-> "none"]
    /\ UNCHANGED cap

Vote(p, v) ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ vote[p] = "none"
    /\ vote' = [vote EXCEPT ![p] = v]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, decision, applied, cap>>

Decide ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ \A p \in Parts : vote[p] # "none"
    /\ decision' = IF (\A p \in Parts : vote[p] = "yes") /\ cap >= 1
                     THEN "commit" ELSE "abort"
    /\ phase' = "decided"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<vote, applied, cap>>

Apply(p) ==
    /\ phase = "decided"
    /\ applied[p] = "none"
    /\ applied' = [applied EXCEPT ![p] = decision]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, vote, decision, cap>>

Reset ==
    /\ phase = "decided"
    /\ \A p \in Parts : applied[p] # "none"
    /\ phase' = "idle"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<vote, decision, applied, cap>>

ChangeCap ==
    /\ \E c \in 0..MAXCAP : cap' = c
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, vote, decision, applied>>

Next ==
    \/ StartVote
    \/ \E p \in Parts, v \in {"yes", "no"} : Vote(p, v)
    \/ Decide
    \/ \E p \in Parts : Apply(p)
    \/ Reset
    \/ ChangeCap

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

AtomicCommit ==
    \A p1 \in Parts, p2 \in Parts :
        (applied[p1] # "none" /\ applied[p2] # "none")
            => (applied[p1] = applied[p2])

====
nl:
A pharmacy prescription dispenser commits each dispense across several
participant stations using two-phase commit, so that the shared dispense record
is updated atomically and no committed update is ever lost. A coordinator opens a
round by asking every station to prepare (the StartVote action). Each station
votes yes or no (the Vote action). Once all stations have voted, the coordinator
decides: it commits only if every station voted yes AND there is dispensing
capacity available, otherwise it aborts (the Decide action). Each station then
applies the single global decision to its local copy of the record (the Apply
action). When all stations have applied, the round resets for the next
prescription (the Reset action). The dispensing capacity is not fixed -- an
operator may change it at runtime (the ChangeCap action). Actions: StartVote,
Vote, Decide, Apply, Reset, ChangeCap.
SAFETY PROPERTY: no two stations ever apply conflicting outcomes for a round -- every station that has applied the record agrees on commit-or-abort.

---- MODULE W4Od18m3p3t1 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

Nodes == {"n1", "n2"}
Locks == {"L1", "L2"}
NONE == "none"
MAXTERM == 2

VARIABLES leader, term, owner, holds, reqs

vars == <<leader, term, owner, holds, reqs>>

Req == [node : Nodes, lock : Locks]

TypeOK ==
    /\ leader \in Nodes \cup {NONE}
    /\ term \in 0..MAXTERM
    /\ owner \in [Locks -> Nodes \cup {NONE}]
    /\ holds \in [Nodes -> Locks \cup {NONE}]
    /\ reqs \subseteq Req

Init ==
    /\ leader = NONE
    /\ term = 0
    /\ owner = [k \in Locks |-> NONE]
    /\ holds = [n \in Nodes |-> NONE]
    /\ reqs = {}

Elect(n) ==
    /\ leader = NONE
    /\ leader' = n
    /\ term' = IF term < MAXTERM THEN term + 1 ELSE term
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, holds, reqs>>

StepDown ==
    /\ leader # NONE
    /\ leader' = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, owner, holds, reqs>>

Request(n, k) ==
    /\ owner[k] = NONE
    /\ holds[n] = NONE
    /\ [node |-> n, lock |-> k] \notin reqs
    /\ reqs' = reqs \cup {[node |-> n, lock |-> k]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, owner, holds>>

Allocate(m) ==
    /\ leader # NONE
    /\ m \in reqs
    /\ owner[m.lock] = NONE
    /\ holds[m.node] = NONE
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![m.lock] = m.node]
    /\ holds' = [holds EXCEPT ![m.node] = m.lock]
    /\ reqs' = reqs \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term>>

Release(n) ==
    /\ holds[n] # NONE
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![holds[n]] = NONE]
    /\ holds' = [holds EXCEPT ![n] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, reqs>>

Next ==
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Elect(n)
    \/ StepDown
    \/ \E n \in Nodes, k \in Locks : Request(n, k)
    \/ \E m \in reqs : Allocate(m)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Release(n)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

MapsAgree ==
    /\ \A n \in Nodes : holds[n] # NONE => owner[holds[n]] = n
    /\ \A k \in Locks : owner[k] # NONE => holds[owner[k]] = k

====
nl:
A smart-home door-lock network is coordinated by a small cluster of server nodes
that elect a single leader; the leader is the only node allowed to allocate a
door lock to a requesting node. Leadership can fail over: the current leader may
step down, leaving no leader, after which any node can be elected leader for a
fresh term (the Elect and StepDown actions). Nodes issue allocation requests for a
specific lock; requests sit in a request pool and, because radio messages can be
reordered, the leader may service ANY pending request, not the oldest (the Request
and Allocate actions). The leader allocates a lock to a requester only when that
lock is currently unallocated and the requester does not already hold a lock, and
it records the allocation in both directions (which node owns the lock, and which
lock the node holds). A node may release the lock it holds (the Release action).
Actions: Elect, StepDown, Request, Allocate, Release.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the lock-to-owner map and the node-to-lock map always agree, so a lock is never allocated to two different nodes at once.

---- MODULE W4Od19m6p0t4 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

Members == {"m1", "m2", "m3"}
NONE == "none"
MAXCLOCK == 3
LEASE == 2
MAXCAP == 2

VARIABLES holder, expiry, clock, cap, inCS

vars == <<holder, expiry, clock, cap, inCS>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ holder \in Members \cup {NONE}
    /\ expiry \in 0..(MAXCLOCK + LEASE)
    /\ clock \in 0..MAXCLOCK
    /\ cap \in 0..MAXCAP
    /\ inCS \subseteq Members

Init ==
    /\ holder = NONE
    /\ expiry = 0
    /\ clock = 0
    /\ cap = 1
    /\ inCS = {}

Acquire(m) ==
    /\ holder = NONE
    /\ cap >= 1
    /\ holder' = m
    /\ expiry' = clock + LEASE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, cap, inCS>>

Enter(m) ==
    /\ holder = m
    /\ expiry > clock
    /\ m \notin inCS
    /\ inCS' = inCS \cup {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, expiry, clock, cap>>

Leave(m) ==
    /\ m \in inCS
    /\ inCS' = inCS \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, expiry, clock, cap>>

Renew(m) ==
    /\ holder = m
    /\ expiry' = clock + LEASE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, clock, cap, inCS>>

Expire ==
    /\ holder # NONE
    /\ expiry <= clock
    /\ holder \notin inCS
    /\ holder' = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<expiry, clock, cap, inCS>>

Tick ==
    /\ clock < MAXCLOCK
    /\ clock' = clock + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, expiry, cap, inCS>>

ChangeCap ==
    /\ \E c \in 0..MAXCAP : cap' = c
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, expiry, clock, inCS>>

Next ==
    \/ \E m \in Members : Acquire(m)
    \/ \E m \in Members : Enter(m)
    \/ \E m \in Members : Leave(m)
    \/ \E m \in Members : Renew(m)
    \/ Expire
    \/ Tick
    \/ ChangeCap

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

MutualExclusion ==
    \A m \in inCS : holder = m

====
nl:
A library book-reservation system protects a single shared reservation ledger
that must be edited by only one member at a time -- the critical resource. A
member takes an exclusive lease on the ledger, stamped with an expiry tick, but
only while at least one editing slot of capacity is available (the Acquire
action). Holding a valid lease, the member enters the critical section to edit
(the Enter action) and later leaves it (the Leave action). A member may renew its
lease to push the expiry further out (the Renew action). A lease whose expiry has
passed is reclaimed, but only when the holder is not currently inside the critical
section (the Expire action). A shared clock advances one tick at a time (the Tick
action). The available editing capacity may change at runtime (the ChangeCap
action). Actions: Acquire, Enter, Leave, Renew, Expire, Tick, ChangeCap.
SAFETY PROPERTY: at most one member is ever inside the critical section editing the ledger at the same time.

---- MODULE W4Od4m3p0t2 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

Instances == {"i1", "i2"}
Nodes == {"a", "b"}
NONE == "none"
MAXTERM == 2

VARIABLES leader, term, occupant, using

vars == <<leader, term, occupant, using>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ leader \in [Instances -> Nodes \cup {NONE}]
    /\ term \in [Instances -> 0..MAXTERM]
    /\ occupant \in Instances \cup {NONE}
    /\ using \in [Instances -> BOOLEAN]

Init ==
    /\ leader = [i \in Instances |-> NONE]
    /\ term = [i \in Instances |-> 0]
    /\ occupant = NONE
    /\ using = [i \in Instances |-> FALSE]

Elect(i, n) ==
    /\ leader[i] = NONE
    /\ leader' = [leader EXCEPT ![i] = n]
    /\ term' = [term EXCEPT ![i] = IF term[i] < MAXTERM THEN term[i] + 1 ELSE term[i]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<occupant, using>>

StepDown(i) ==
    /\ leader[i] # NONE
    /\ ~ using[i]
    /\ leader' = [leader EXCEPT ![i] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, occupant, using>>

Enter(i) ==
    /\ leader[i] # NONE
    /\ occupant = NONE
    /\ ~ using[i]
    /\ occupant' = i
    /\ using' = [using EXCEPT ![i] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term>>

Exit(i) ==

    /\ UNCHANGED <<vote, requester, inChute, cap>>

Enter ==
    /\ phase = "decided"
    /\ decision = "commit"
    /\ Cardinality(inChute) = 0
    /\ requester # NONE
    /\ inChute' = {requester}
    /\ phase' = "idle"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<vote, decision, requester, cap>>

AbortRound ==
    /\ phase = "decided"
    /\ decision = "abort"
    /\ phase' = "idle"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<vote, decision, requester, inChute, cap>>

Leave(r) ==
    /\ r \in inChute
    /\ inChute' = inChute \ {r}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, vote, decision, requester, cap>>

ChangeCap ==
    /\ \E c \in 0..MAXCAP : cap' = c
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, vote, decision, requester, inChute>>

Next ==
    \/ \E r \in Lines : Request(r)
    \/ \E p \in Parts, v \in {"yes", "no"} : Vote(p, v)
    \/ Decide
    \/ Enter
    \/ AbortRound
    \/ \E r \in Lines : Leave(r)
    \/ ChangeCap

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

MutualExclusion == Cardinality(inChute) <= 1

nl:
An airport baggage router shares a single critical sorting chute that only one
router line may occupy at a time. Access is granted through two-phase commit across
participant sensor controllers: a router line requests entry, opening a voting
round (the Request action). Each participant votes yes or no (the Vote action).
Once all have voted, the coordinator decides: it commits only if every participant
voted yes, there is sorting capacity available, and the chute is currently empty;
otherwise it aborts (the Decide action). On a commit, the requesting line enters
the chute (the Enter action); on an abort, the round simply closes (the AbortRound
action). A line in the chute eventually exits, freeing it (the Leave action). The
sorting capacity may change at runtime (the ChangeCap action). Actions: Request,
Vote, Decide, Enter, AbortRound, Leave, ChangeCap.
SAFETY PROPERTY: at most one router line ever occupies the shared sorting chute at the same time.
